name: Agent Payment Node
description: Local-first payment runtime with a stdio MCP server for x402 offer inspection, bounded payment preparation, status and receipt recovery. Apple Silicon macOS and Node 24 only. Direct transfers and EVM x402 signing require foreground owner approval; Solana exact x402 can execute under owner-admitted policy.

requirements.other: Apple Silicon macOS; no Linux, Windows, Docker or hosted MCP endpoint.

features: Foreground signing and owner-admitted payment policies
